metadata.ut_note: All Julian Days are UT; inputs treated as UTC (UT ~= UTC here).
metadata.notes: For each random start instant, the next end time of the current limb, found by sub-second root finding on Swiss Ephemeris longitudes. Definitions: tithi = floor(wrap(moon_trop - sun_trop)/12); karana = floor(wrap(moon_trop - sun_trop)/6) (60 half-tithi indices); nakshatra = floor(wrap(moon_sidereal)/(360/27)); yoga = floor(wrap(sun_sidereal + moon_sidereal)/(360/27)). end_utc is the first instant at which the index has changed.
